messages:
Sasha: Heads up — VendorHub just dropped an updated pricing CSV for Q3 SKUs. We need to confirm whether their `commit_tier` maps to our notion of reserved instances or to marketplace-level reserved SKUs. Link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/vendorhub/redwood/Q3_SKU_update_2166001234.csv
Mike: Quick Q — does that CSV use hourly granularity? We bill per GPU-hour but our billing engine expects per-second. Also need region normalization (us-east-1 vs eu-west-1).
Vendor-ops: New file uploaded to S3: s3://vendorhub/redwood/Q3_SKU_update_2166001234.csv (sha256: d4c3b2...). Columns sent: sku_id,region,commit_tier,price_per_hour,spot_floor,deprecation_notice,availability_start,availability_end
Anita: @Sasha can you ask them to include a `marketplace_product_id` column? Last time SKU renames broke our mapping. Also ask for explicit deprecation window semantics — when they set `deprecation_notice` is it advisory or enforced?
Sasha: Already pinged vendor. They said `deprecation_notice` is their "end-of-life" date but marketplaces may keep listings live for TTL. Their sample header is: ```sku_id,region,commit_tier,price_per_hour,spot_floor,deprecation_notice,availability_start,availability_end```
Hector: Two asks from infra: 1) Clarify whether `commit_tier` == guaranteed reserved capacity or a discount ladder (optional). 2) Define expected failover behavior for spot eviction — do they provide an alternate spot pool or should we fallback to Dedicated/commit? We need that to model SLA impact.
Mike: Also need to know whether `price_per_hour` is net of marketplace listing fee or gross. 7-12% marketplace cut changes our unit economics a lot.
Anita: Requesting they provide price points for 1/6/12/24 month terms and historical regional spot eviction rates (30d). If they can add `time_to_fulfill_hours` for reserved SKUs that'd help queueing logic.
Vendor-ops: Noted. We'll add `marketplace_product_id`, 1/6/12/24 month pricing columns, `time_to_fulfill_hours`, and a `listing_fee_included` boolean. Eviction rates by region: compiling, will send by EOD.
Sasha: Plan: once we have the augmented CSV we'll run an ingest and validate the mapping. @Mike can you confirm our cost model has a `listing_fee_included` toggle?
Mike: Yes — I'll add the flag and a sanity check that finds >5% variance vs previous price inputs and flags it. Also propose a temporary "parity_lock" rule: if availability_end - availability_start < 90 days for a region, we treat that region as non-committable. Saves us surprises.
Hector: +1 on parity_lock. Also recommend `eviction_probability_30d` column so modeling can probabilistically blend reserved vs fallback cost.
Vendor-ops: Will include `eviction_probability_30d` (percent) and push file update today. Sample row we'll provide: ```"sku-aws-p4d","us-east-1","tier-3","12.50","3.00","2025-12-01","2025-06-01","2026-06-01", "marketplace-9876", "time_to_fulfill_hours:48", "listing_fee_included:false", "eviction_probability_30d:5"```
Sasha: Perfect — thanks. If ingestion fails I'll open a follow-up in eng-ops. :thumbsup:
